candidates.title: Police constable drowns in Mancherial tank during morning walk
candidates.excerpt: A 37-year-old police constable, Sammanna, drowned in an irrigation tank at Dugnepalli village in Mancherial district on Thursday. Police said he slipped into the water while walking along the tank bund in the morning and died at the spot.
